questions.question_text: Why must composite keys (id_student, code_module, code_presentation) be used when merging OULAD tables?
options: Students only take one module in their lifetime
A student can enroll in multiple modules and presentations across different terms
Primary keys are optional in pandas
It prevents missing value imputation
questions.explanation: OULAD tracks students across multiple course presentations, so student ID alone is not unique.

questions.question_text: What is temporal data leakage in early-semester academic risk prediction?
options: Deleting missing rows from the CSV
Using post-cutoff events like final exam scores or unregistration dates to predict early risk
Normalizing numerical columns with StandardScaler
Using Logistic Regression instead of Random Forest
questions.explanation: Leakage occurs when future information (which wouldn't be available at day T) accidentally enters the feature set.

questions.question_text: Which model metric is generally most robust for evaluating imbalanced academic risk datasets?
options: Accuracy
ROC-AUC and F1-Score
Total row count
Execution time
questions.explanation: ROC-AUC and F1-score account for class imbalance between passing and failing students much better than raw accuracy.

questions.question_text: What is the primary difference between SHAP and LIME?
options: SHAP relies on cooperative game theory (Shapley values) for consistent attribution, whereas LIME trains a local surrogate model
SHAP only works for linear regression
LIME requires GPU acceleration
There is no difference
questions.explanation: SHAP provides theoretically guaranteed additive feature attribution based on Shapley values.

questions.question_text: In Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), what does a high Slip probability P(S) represent?
options: The student guessed the answer correctly without knowing the concept
The student knows the concept but made a mistake or careless error
The student dropped out of the course
The model is 100% accurate
questions.explanation: Slip probability accounts for students who have mastered the skill but still answer incorrectly due to noise or fatigue.
